title: ChatGPT's new Wallet lets AI agents shop and check out for you | TechCrunch
summary: On Friday, OpenAI launched a new wallet feature that lets its agents, called dots , help you decide what to buy and then complete the purchase on your behalf. Other personal AI agents, like Instinct, also support making purchases on users’ behalf.
